  (∀ a ∈ levi W τ, ∀ g, κ (conjSubst ι a g) = κ g) ∧ (∀ α, weight (x ·.1) α ≠ weight (x ·.2) α
  → κ (monomial α 1) = 0) ∧ (∀ α, P (weight (x ·.1) α) → κ (monomial α 1) = if degree α ≤ D then p ^
  (k ^ 2 * f) • eval (vec 1) (monomial α 1) else 0) ∧ κ ∈ span O {l ∘ₗ (conjSubst ι u).toLinearMap |
  (u ∈ levi W τ) (l : Dual O _) (_ : ∀ α, ¬P (weight (x ·.1) α) → l (monomial α 1) = 0)}

    (span {T.w ^ c}) θ) ∧ (∀ y ∈ T.excessCond n a r (span {T.w ^ c}) (θ - (4 * c + 2)), ∀ F,
    T.w ^ c ∣ y ⬝ᵥ (b * Z *ᵥ F) - T.p ^ ((k + k ^ 2) * (T.o₀ * N) * N) * y ⬝ᵥ F) ∧

hecke.name: TwistingData.hasType_twisted_hecke

lemma hasType_twisted_hecke (hp : ¬IsUnit (T.p : O)) {r ℓ κ y z} (big : HeckeSizes T.P T.o₀ N k n r
  ℓ κ y z) {I M : Type} [Fintype H] [Fintype (_ ⧸ parahoric W (twoBlock k r))] [Fintype I]
  [AddCommGroup M] [Module O M] (f : (X → I → O) →ₗ[O] M) {Y : End O M} (src :
  X × _ ⧸ parahoric W (twoBlock k r) → X) (g : _ → GL (Fin k) W) (u : _ → GL H O) (J : I ≃ _ × H)
  (hs : Injective fun e ↦ ((src e, ↑(transposeGL (g e))⁻¹) : X × _ ⧸ parahoric W (twoBlock k r)))
  (hY : ∀ F, Y (f F) = f fun c i ↦ ∑ b, ∑ j, u (c, b) (J i).2 (J j).2 * (T.letterRep n (g (c, b)) *
  diagonal ((T.p : O) ^ T.depth k n r ·) * T.letterRep n b.out⁻¹ :) (J j).1 (J i).1 * F (src (c, b))
  j) m : HasType ↑T.p f.range m Y ((z + κ * m + y) * (Nat.card X * Nat.card I))

TwD.name: TwistingData
TwD.statement:
structure TwistingData where
  (p o₀ : ℕ) ι : ZMod N → W →+* R
  isEven : ZMod N → _
  w : R
  prime : p.Prime
  five_le_P : 5 ≤ p ^ o₀
  w_sq : w ^ 2 = p
  frobenius_congr s x : ↑p ∣ ι (s + 1) x - ι s x ^ p ^ o₀
  isEven_succ s : isEven (s + 1) = !isEven s
  card_residueField : .card (ResidueField W) = (p ^ o₀) ^ N

Tmap.name: TwistingData.map

letterMatrix.name: TwistingData.letterMatrix
letterMatrix.statement:
@[simps -isSimp] def letterMatrix := MonoidHom.mk ⟨fun g : GL (Fin k) W ↦
  (ite (T.isEven s) ↑g g⁻¹.1ᵀ).map (T.ι s), by simp⟩ (by bound)

polyAction.name: TwistingData.polyAction
polyAction.statement:
def polyAction := MonoidHom.mk ⟨fun g ↦ linSubst (blockDiagonal (T.letterMatrix (k := k) · g)),
  by simp [← Pi.one_def]⟩ (by simp)

letterRep.name: TwistingData.letterRep
letterRep.statement:
@[simps -isSimp] def letterRep := MonoidHom.mk ⟨fun g ↦
  kroneckerPi (symPowMatrix n <| T.letterMatrix (k := k) · g), by simp⟩ (by simp [kroneckerPi_mul])

dpi.name: TwistingData.deepIndicator
dpi.statement: def deepIndicator := if T.isEven x.2 ↔ r ≤ x.1 then 1 else 0

depth.name: TwistingData.depth
depth.statement: def depth k n r β := (exponentOf (a := n) β).weight (T.deepIndicator (k := k) r)

rootVar.name: TwistingData.rootVar
rootVar.statement: @[simps] def rootVar := (ite (T.isEven s) a' a, s)

exw.name: TwistingData.excessWeight
exw.statement:
def excessWeight := (ite (x = T.rootVar a a' x.2) (T.P ^ (1 + (x.2 - 1 - i).val)) 0 -
  ite (x = T.rootVar a' a x.2) (T.P ^ (x.2 - i).val) 0 : ℝ) / T.q

translatesIn.name: TwistingData.translatesIn
translatesIn.statement:
def translatesIn τ (I : Ideal R) (B : Set _) := (⟨⟨⟨{F | ∀ g ∈ @levi k W _ τ, ∀ β ∈ B,
  (T.letterRep n g *ᵥ F) β ∈ I}, by aesop⟩, by simp⟩, by simp_all [mul_mem_left]⟩ : Submodule R _)

excessCond.name: TwistingData.excessCond
excessCond.statement:
abbrev excessCond I h :=
  T.translatesIn n (twoBlock k a') I {β | ∃ i, h < (exponentOf β).weight (T.excessWeight i a a')}

deepForms.name: TwistingData.deepForms
deepForms.statement: abbrev deepForms k n r d := T.translatesIn n 0 ⊥ {β | T.depth k n r β < d}

frobpow.name: TwistingData.frobenius_pow_congr
frobpow.statement: lemma frobenius_pow_congr x : ↑T.p ∣ T.ι (s + n) x - T.ι s x ^ T.P ^ n

finres.name: TwistingData.finite_residueField
finres.statement: include T in lemma finite_residueField : Finite (ResidueField W)

pdvdpar.name: TwistingData.p_dvd_letterMatrix_of_mem_parahoric
pdvdpar.statement:
lemma p_dvd_letterMatrix_of_mem_parahoric (hg : g ∈ parahoric W τ) i j (h : ite (T.isEven s)
  (τ i < τ j) (τ j < τ i)) : ↑T.p ∣ T.letterMatrix s g i j

binders.name: h
binders.type: ite (T.isEven s) (τ i < τ j) (τ j < τ i)

polyActionX.name: TwistingData.polyAction_X
polyActionX.statement:
lemma polyAction_X : T.polyAction g (X x) = ∑ b,
  C (T.letterMatrix x.2 g b x.1) * X (b, x.2)

diagdepth.name: TwistingData.diagonal_pow_depth
diagdepth.statement:
lemma diagonal_pow_depth (x : R) : diagonal (x ^ T.depth k n r ·) = kroneckerPi fun s ↦
  symPowMatrix n (diagonal (n := Fin k) (x ^ T.deepIndicator r ⟨·, s⟩))

polyOfCoeffs.name: TwistingData.polyAction_polyOfCoeffs
polyOfCoeffs.statement:
lemma polyAction_polyOfCoeffs F : T.polyAction g (polyOfCoeffs F) =
  polyOfCoeffs (T.letterRep n g *ᵥ F)

letterRepmap.name: TwistingData.letterRep_map
letterRepmap.statement: lemma letterRep_map : (T.map φ).letterRep n g = (T.letterRep n g).map φ

oneaddval.name: TwistingData.one_add_val_sub_one_sub
oneaddval.statement: @[simp] lemma one_add_val_sub_one_sub : 1 + (s - 1 - i).val = ite (s = i) N (s - i).val

exwIcc.name: TwistingData.excessWeight_mem_Icc
exwIcc.statement: lemma excessWeight_mem_Icc : T.excessWeight i a a' x ∈ Set.Icc (-5⁻¹) 1

IndexDvd.name: IndexDvd
IndexDvd.statement: def IndexDvd := ∀ n (Φ : Fin n → V), (∀ k, Φ k ∈ M) → ∃ m, det m ∣ z ∧ ∀ i, ∑ k, m i k • Φ k ∈ N

HasType.name: HasType
HasType.statement:
def HasType p M n (y : End O V) (c : ℝ) :=
  M.map y ≤ M ∧ ∃ l : ℕ, l ≤ c ∧ IndexDvd M (M.map y ⊔ p ^ n • M) (p ^ l)

ofdetdvd.name: IndexDvd.of_det_dvd
ofdetdvd.statement:
lemma IndexDvd.of_det_dvd [IsDomain O] [ValuationRing O] [Fintype ι] {A : Matrix ι ι O} {N}
    (h : A.det ∣ z) (e : .map A.mulVecLin ⊤ ≤ N) : IndexDvd ⊤ N z

idtrans.name: IndexDvd.trans
idtrans.statement: lemma IndexDvd.trans (h : IndexDvd M N z) (g : IndexDvd N P a) : IndexDvd M P (z * a)

idmap.name: IndexDvd.map
idmap.statement:
lemma IndexDvd.map (h : IndexDvd M N z) (f : V →ₗ[O] U) : M' ≤ M.map f ⊔ N' → N.map f ≤ N' →
  IndexDvd M' N' z

idcomp.name: IndexDvd.comp
idcomp.statement:
lemma IndexDvd.comp (e : M.map f ≤ M) : IndexDvd M (M.map f ⊔ a • M) z → IndexDvd M (N ⊔ a • M) z' →
  IndexDvd M (N.map f ⊔ a • M) (z * z')

binders.type: IndexDvd M (M.map f ⊔ a • M) z

hermite.name: IsValuationPair.hermite
hermite.statement:
lemma IsValuationPair.hermite y (wt : k → ℕ := 0) : ∃ᵉ (U ∈ intGL n R) (D : Matrix k k A),
    D.BlockTriangular wt ∧ y = U.1.submatrix id ι * D ∧ U⁻¹.1.submatrix ι id * y = D

smith.name: IsValuationPair.smith_normal_form
smith.statement:
lemma IsValuationPair.smith_normal_form {A n} [CommRing A] {R} [Fintype n] (val : @IsValuationPair A
  _ R) y : ∃ᵉ (k ∈ intGL n R) (k' ∈ intGL n R) (d), y = k.1 * diagonal d * k'.1

nullst.name: exists_le_cost_of_vanishing
nullst.statement:
lemma exists_le_cost_of_vanishing {K ι S : Type} [Field K] [Fintype ι] [Fintype S] (κ : ι → ℕ)
    (κ0 : ∀ u, 0 < κ u) (z : S → _) (inj : z.Injective) (card : ∏ u, κ u ≤ Fintype.card S)
    (hz : ∀ u, ∃ g : MvPolynomial ι K, (∀ α ∈ g.support, weight (κ · : ι → ℝ)⁻¹ α < 1) ∧
      ∀ t, MvPolynomial.eval (z t) g = z t u ^ κ u) (d : ℕ) f (f0 : f ≠ 0) (hf : ∀ t,
    f ∈ vanishingIdeal K {z t} ^ d) : ∃ α ∈ f.support, d ≤ weight (κ · : ι → ℝ)⁻¹ α

binders.name: hz
binders.type: ∀ u, ∃ g : MvPolynomial ι K, (∀ α ∈ g.support, weight (κ · : ι → ℝ)⁻¹ α < 1) ∧ ∀ t, MvPolynomial.eval (z t) g = z t u ^ κ u

binders.name: hf
binders.type: ∀ t, f ∈ vanishingIdeal K {z t} ^ d

cardGL.name: card_GL_eq_prod
cardGL.statement:
lemma card_GL_eq_prod {n R} [Fintype n] [Field R] : Nat.card (GL n k) =
  ∏ i ∈ range (Fintype.card n), (Nat.card k ^ i * (Nat.card k ^ (i + 1) - 1) : R)
